name: gt-company-formation
description: Use this Guatemala guide to set up a company in 2026, from the notarial deed to the Registro Mercantil, SAT and IGSS. Match requests such as register a company in Guatemala, constituir sociedad anónima, sociedad de responsabilidad limitada, escritura constitutiva, Registro Mercantil inscripción, patente de sociedad, capital mínimo Q200, arancel Registro Mercantil, sucursal de sociedad extranjera, NIT empresa, RTU, and branch of a foreign company Guatemala. It walks the steps in order, states the capital rules of Código de Comercio articles 90 and 92 as the Registro Mercantil applies them, the registry fee codes, and the tax registrations that follow. This Tier 2 draft supports source checking and reviewer questions; it does not authorise filing, payment or a legal position.
